about: L8 B5 Scoped result-release mutants; runtime tests run in process. The standard mutant runner currently measures compiler suites only; the unit's runtime runner applies each edit in a scratch copy.

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-result-lost
mutants.rule: Gap 47: a discarded successful result is released once

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-failed-candidate
mutants.rule: A failed body has no valid result

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-unmasked
mutants.from:
m := t.Mask()
				s.runRelease(entry{run: closeWith[T]{release}, v: left}, &c)
				m.Unmask()
mutants.rule: R9: result releases are masked

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-defect-lost
mutants.rule: R9: a result-release defect joins the failed exit

mutants.name: X5-new-task-runs-unpicked
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: a new task does not run until the strategy picks it

mutants.name: X5-wake-does-not-enable
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: a waker enables the task it wakes

mutants.name: X5-two-batons
mutants.from:
x.next = op
	next := e.handoff(x)
	e.v.mu.Unlock()
	if next != x {
mutants.to:
x.next = op
	next := e.handoff(x)
	e.v.mu.Unlock()
	if false && next != x {
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: one task holds the baton

mutants.name: X5-stop-without-point
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: a stop is a scheduling point

mutants.name: X5-clock-moves-while-enabled
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: the clock moves only when no task is enabled

mutants.name: X5-spawn-path-by-goroutine
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: a task's name is its spawn path, the same in every run of a schedule

mutants.name: X5-deadlock-as-pass
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: no enabled task while tasks remain is a deadlock

mutants.name: X5-live-hook-body
mutants.rule: Explored schedules 7: without the tag a hook costs nothing

mutants.name: X5-hook-argument-calls
mutants.rule: Explored schedules 7: a hook's arguments are plain values

mutants.name: X5-hook-closure-unguarded
mutants.rule: Explored schedules 7: a hook call that builds a closure sits inside if rt.Exploring

mutants.name: X5-tags-not-linked
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: --explore links the tagged runtime

mutants.name: x8-name-no-count
mutants.rule: The k-th handle of one name in a run is named "name (k)".

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-no-error
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.Text writes an error as fmt's %v does, by its Error method.

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-int
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.Text writes every Go integer kind as fmt's %v does.

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-nil-pointer
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): an Error method that panics on a nil pointer writes <nil>, as fmt does.

mutants.name: bs2-typename-generic
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.TypeName gives reflect's Type.Name, a generic type's name with its arguments.

mutants.name: ert-abort-ignored
mutants.rule: AbortExplore ends the active explored run and frees the explorer, even when a task waits where the scheduler cannot see.
